### Selected Story
What cone-mode sparse checkout includes

### Story Progression
- **Context:** Sparse checkout changes which tracked files are present in the working tree.
- **Development:** Cone mode selects directories and includes all files recursively under them.
- **Endpoint:** It also includes files that are siblings of the selected directory or any ancestor directory.

### Critical Constraints
- Preserve the scope and qualifications of the developments.
